role: Own implementation, not an independent safety review
implemented: Preview worker handles arbitrary exact managed saved profile scopes without the production current-lesson guest fence. It still requires a fresh stateful Local GlobalAdmin preparation guard.
Captured source global revision, management identity, saved public layout and optional exact saved subject document form a baseline. All draft structures/styles/composition validate before traversal.

Saved independent nodes are read through Backend.read_profile_content with error propagation. Only a fresh ID above the baseline high water (or a genuinely unsaved subject profile) receives Empty. Retired IDs/type changes/saved profile ID mismatches are explicit errors.
Text uses actual current payload plus snapshot scalars/UTF8 bytes and TextFrame.insert_verified SHA256. No placeholder body or fake media reference is published.
Only selected subject content or public outlet fallback is hydrated, never both.

One fixed now supplies both shared DWrite/layout measurement and UI rendering. Image requests come from the same image_requests_with_content geometry; no parallel layout/Contain authority is introduced.
Backend mutex is released before UTF8 hashing, DWrite, original file reads, hash verification, and WIC. All file work stays on the existing shared worker pool.

ControlledContentFiles.decode_current verifies the actual immutable original pin and produces an accounted RasterFrame in the same process-shared32MiB cache. Returned frame Arcs remain owned until UI finishes rendering.

Whole batch has cooperative30s wall/10s CPU plus JobContext checkpoints. AuthorityUpdating pauses5ms at a time with deadline/cancel checks; it is not permanent lease revocation. Healthy source change or actual revocation discards the snapshot.

Final management authorization, global revision, public/subject baselines and every saved slot content revision/view revision/current descriptor are read again before return. source_revision enables root UI before/after-render freshness checks.

limits: No new management preview or controller runtime execution by this agent. The two new slot-contract tests are pure checks, not proof of DPAPI/SQLite/WIC end-to-end preview behavior.

Root central UI integration is owned/reviewed by root; its existing role/source before/after checks and keeping images alive through render are integration requirements, not this producer independent-review evidence.
